title: Why avocado and lime Works So Well Together
flavorProfile: Avocado offers a rich, buttery creaminess with subtle earthy undertones, while lime contributes bright, tangy citrus acidity. Together they create a harmonious balance of savory depth, natural sweetness, and vibrant umami complexity.
nutritionalSynergy: Lime is packed with vitamin C (about 30% DV per 1/4 cup) which significantly enhances the absorption of non-heme iron from plant-based sources found in avocado and other ingredients. Additionally, the monounsaturated fats in avocado improve the bioavailability of fat-soluble nutrients like vitamin E and carotenoids when consumed alongside acidic components such as lime. The combination also provides a synergistic antioxidant effect—vitamin C in lime works with the polyphenols in avocado to combat oxidative stress.
prepTechniques: Wash avocados thoroughly under cool running water and pat dry
Halve each avocado lengthwise, remove the pit, and gently scoop the flesh into a bowl
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the avocado, then fold in minced garlic, salt, and optional cilantro or chili flakes before serving

faq.a: Transfer remaining avocado-lime mixture to an airtight container and refrigerate. Consume within 24 hours for best texture and flavor. If the surface begins to brown, it is normal due to oxidation; consume immediately.

Yes. For a similar flavor profile, you can use green apple instead of avocado for crunch, or lemon instead of lime for a different citrus note. However, the creamy texture and lipid content of avocado are essential for the full flavor synergy with lime.
